answer: Neighborhood overlap admission filter. It samples recent counterparty topology and grants full-rate acceptance only when neighbor overlap with co-arriving peers is low and the agent has aged edges into distinct incumbent regions, like a vine reaching separate soil patches. Co-created identities share too many neighbors, so the sampled matrix marks that dense block in saffron. Each identity then needs its own non-overlapping live links across multiple epochs, and copied links trigger throttling; the admission map stays umber until those edges age.
